        long[] ones = new long[17];
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            ones[i] = 10 * ones[i - 1] + 1;
        }
        Map<String, Long> memo = new HashMap<>();
        long ans = dfsMemo(ones, n, 16, memo);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    private static long dfsMemo(long[] ones, long n, int idx, Map<String, Long> memo) {
        String key = n + "," + idx;
        if (memo.containsKey(key)) return memo.get(key);
        long quot = n / ones[idx];
        long rem = n % ones[idx];
        long used = quot * idx;
        long result;

            result = used;
        } else {
            result = used + Math.min(dfsMemo(ones, rem, idx - 1, memo),
                    idx + dfsMemo(ones, ones[idx] - rem, idx - 1, memo));
        }
        memo.put(key, result);
        return result;
    }

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class OneBasedArithmeticV4 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastReader sc = new FastReader();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long[] ones = new long[17];
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            ones[i] = ones[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long ans = solve(ones, n);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    private static long solve(long[] ones, long n) {
        return dfs(ones, n, 16);
    }

    private static long dfs(long[] ones, long n, int idx) {
        if (idx == 0) {
            // base case: only ones[0]=0, but we never reach here because n will be 0 before idx=0
            return 0;
        }
        long quot = n / ones[idx];
        long rem = n % ones[idx];
        long used = quot * idx;
        if (rem == 0) return used;
        long option1 = dfs(ones, rem, idx - 1);
        long option2 = idx + dfs(ones, ones[idx] - rem, idx - 1);
        return used + Math.min(option1, option2);
    }

    private static class FastReader {
        private final BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        public FastReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }
}
